status: Development diagnostic registered after E007 probability results, before inspecting selected-trade outcomes. This is not an executable backtest.
decision: At each eligible complete six-bracket event, consider buying one YES or one NO. YES price is raw ask; NO price is one minus raw YES bid. Apply each scenario's slippage and fee; reject price>=1. Choose the greatest model probability minus total cost, if strictly positive. Deterministic ties by ticker then side. At most one conditional one-contract purchase per event per model/scenario. No confidence lower bound is claimed.
fee_limits: Quadratic coefficient 0.07 with scenario multipliers and explicit rounding. These are cost assumptions based on the retrieved 2026 schedule, NOT verified contemporaneous 2025 fees. No fee backdating claim; zero-fee scenario is a gross diagnostic.
fills: Unit fill at the archived candle quote plus the assumed slippage is CONDITIONAL and unproven. No displayed size, receipt-time latency, partial fills, cancellations or adverse-selection model. A positive result cannot establish execution. No maker fills.
outcome: Conditional held-to-final-resolution payout from the original binary contract result. Retain every attempt and abstention, entry cost, expected edge, and realized unit outcome. No reinvestment, geometric growth, available bankroll, capital-lockup return or ruin probabilities are inferred.
calendar_policy: For this conditional trading rule only, all 92 validation source dates remain in the calendar; no complete quoted event or no positive expected edge means no conditional purchase and zero conditional P&L. Zeros represent policy abstention, never invented prices or probabilities. This is a different estimand from E007 conditional forecast accuracy, whose missing-date confidence stays unavailable.
uncertainty: Sum conditional unit P&L across cities/events within each source day. Circular blocks 1/7/14, 10000 resamples, seed20260906. Approximate one-sided positive-mean diagnostics versus no-purchase cash. Holm over all 9 models x 3 scenarios x 3 block choices (81 diagnostics); this does not replace the global all-experiment promotion correction or actual execution evidence.
